title: **Happy Birthday to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution – 17 Shahrivar / 8 September**
text:
"**Happy Birthday to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution – 17 Shahrivar / 8 September**"

"**On the Occasion of His Birthday – 17 Shahrivar 1348 (8 September 1969)**"
"Born in the holy city of Mashhad."

"**🔹 Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei: A Profile**"

"- A veteran of the Sacred Defense"
"- Trusted companion of the martyred Commander Haj Qasem Soleimani"
"- Strategic advisor to Seyyed Hassan Nasrallah"
"- The rankless commander of the Axis of Resistance"
"- Scion of a family adorned with martyrdom
